questions.question: Kubernetes là gì và tại sao cần thiết?

options.B: K8s: container orchestration platform — tự động deploy, scale, self-heal, load balance containers

questions.explanation: Kubernetes: orchestrate containers at scale. Problems it solves: (1) Deployment: rolling updates, rollbacks. (2) Scaling: horizontal pod autoscaling. (3) Self-healing: restart failed containers, reschedule on node failure. (4) Service discovery & load balancing. (5) Config & secrets management. (6) Storage orchestration. K8s objects: Pod, Deployment, Service, ConfigMap, Secret, PersistentVolume, Ingress, HorizontalPodAutoscaler. kubectl: CLI tool.

questions.question: Pod, Deployment, Service — mối quan hệ?

options.B: Pod: smallest deployable unit (1+ containers). Deployment: manage Pod replicas (desired state). Service: stable network endpoint cho Pod set (load balancer)

questions.explanation: Pod: 1 hoặc nhiều containers share network (localhost) và storage. Ephemeral — có thể bị killed. Deployment: declare desired state (replicas: 3), K8s ensure actual = desired. Rolling update, rollback. ReplicaSet: Deployment manage. Service types: ClusterIP (internal), NodePort (external via node IP:port), LoadBalancer (cloud LB), ExternalName. Service selector: match Pod labels. Endpoints: list of Pod IPs behind Service.

questions.question: ConfigMap và Secret trong Kubernetes?

options.B: ConfigMap: non-sensitive config (env vars, config files). Secret: sensitive data (passwords, tokens) — base64 encoded, not encrypted by default

questions.explanation: ConfigMap: kubectl create configmap app-config --from-literal=DB_HOST=postgres. Mount as env vars hoặc volume. Secret: kubectl create secret generic db-secret --from-literal=password=secret123 — base64 encoded (không phải encrypted!). Encrypt secrets at rest: EncryptionConfiguration. External Secrets Operator: sync từ AWS Secrets Manager/Vault vào K8s Secrets. envFrom: configMapRef/secretRef để inject tất cả keys. secretKeyRef: inject specific key.

questions.question: Kubernetes resource requests và limits?

options.B: requests: minimum guaranteed resources (scheduling). limits: maximum allowed (enforce). Set để prevent noisy neighbor, enable proper scheduling

questions.explanation: resources: requests: memory:'256Mi'; cpu:'250m'. limits: memory:'512Mi'; cpu:'500m'. Requests: dùng cho scheduling (scheduler tìm node có enough resources). Guaranteed QoS: requests == limits. Burstable: limits > requests. BestEffort: no requests/limits (evicted first). 250m = 0.25 CPU core. OOMKilled: container vượt memory limit → killed. CPU throttled: vượt CPU limit → throttled, không killed. LimitRange: default limits per namespace. ResourceQuota: total limits per namespace.

questions.question: Kubernetes Health checks — liveness, readiness, startup probes?

options.B: Liveness: nếu fail → restart container. Readiness: nếu fail → remove từ Service endpoints (no traffic). Startup: cho slow-starting apps, disable liveness/readiness until ready

questions.explanation: Liveness probe: là container còn alive không? Fail → restart. HTTP GET, TCP socket, exec command. readinessProbe: là container ready nhận traffic không? Fail → remove từ Service endpoints (no LB traffic). startupProbe: cho apps khởi động chậm (60s+) — disable liveness/readiness cho đến khi startup probe succeed. Config: initialDelaySeconds, periodSeconds, failureThreshold. Ví dụ: livenessProbe: httpGet: path: /health; port: 8080; initialDelaySeconds: 30; periodSeconds: 10.

questions.question: Kubernetes Ingress và SSL termination?

options.B: Ingress: L7 routing (host/path-based) → Service. Ingress Controller (Nginx/Traefik): implement Ingress rules. cert-manager: tự động SSL từ Let's Encrypt
options.D: SSL chỉ cần ở code level

questions.explanation: Ingress resource: rules - host: api.example.com → paths: /users → serviceName: user-service. Ingress Controller phải được deploy (Nginx Ingress, Traefik, Kong). cert-manager: CertificateRequest → Let's Encrypt ACME → TLS Secret → Ingress tls: field. Wildcard cert: *.example.com với DNS challenge. TLS termination tại Ingress: pod không cần HTTPS. Annotations: nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target, rate limiting, CORS. MetalLB: LoadBalancer cho bare-metal clusters.

questions.question: Pod ở trạng thái CrashLoopBackOff — debug thế nào?

options.B: kubectl logs pod-name --previous, kubectl describe pod, check liveness probe, resource limits, config/secrets, image pull errors

questions.explanation: Debug steps: (1) kubectl get pods: thấy CrashLoopBackOff. (2) kubectl logs pod-name (hoặc --previous cho last crash). (3) kubectl describe pod pod-name: Events section — image pull error? OOMKilled? Liveness probe failed? (4) kubectl exec -it pod-name -- /bin/sh: nếu pod còn running. (5) Common causes: app crash on startup (check logs), OOMKilled (increase memory limits), liveness probe failing before app ready (use startupProbe), missing env vars/secrets, wrong image tag, readOnly filesystem. kubectl events --namespace: tất cả events trong namespace.

questions.question: HPA (Horizontal Pod Autoscaler) setup cho Spring Boot app?

options.B: HPA: scale pods dựa trên CPU/memory/custom metrics. Metrics Server cần thiết. Target CPU 70%. Kubernetes Event-driven Autoscaling (KEDA) cho advanced metrics

questions.explanation: Prerequisites: Metrics Server deployed (kubectl top pods). HPA: kubectl autoscale deployment api-deployment --cpu-percent=70 --min=2 --max=10. Manifest: spec: scaleTargetRef, minReplicas, maxReplicas, metrics: type:Resource, resource: name:cpu, target: averageUtilization:70. KEDA: scale to zero, custom metrics (Kafka lag, queue depth, HTTP requests). VPA (Vertical Pod Autoscaler): tự điều chỉnh requests/limits. Cluster Autoscaler: add/remove nodes khi Pods pending. Combination: HPA + Cluster Autoscaler = full autoscaling stack.
